Figure 1 = fig1_main (C), Figure 5 = fig5_excess_C, Figure 6 = fig1_main_R (R; 09 via 2e, 10-18: it reads no R37). Each figure checks the label sidecar of EVERY record it draws (09 via 2e, 10-18): A through --label-sidecar and --label-sha (6100557b..., 09's registered A string); each DERIVED record (group catch, pw shares, four-probe excess) through --input-sidecar with its step name, under 09's composed-label rule: the label starts with exactly A's registered label bytes and continues with " | <step> on route C pooled A @ <the A record drawn>", contains PRELIMINARY, and its sidecar names that record's own sha. A's meta is re-asserted by key in the render container (--record-meta). Every fill token is filled at the S2 go from 09's S2-signed records and the group / pw records' committed outputs; render_all STOPs while any remains.
